newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see light nearby trade.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see light nearby trade.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained quietly this afternoon with only a few nearby trades reported, market sources said.
"A slight dip in the dollar and a stronger start of old crop soymeal futures this afternoon caused light covering of immediate needs," one broker said.

Afloat Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $275 a tonne cif Ghent. Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets changed hands at $259 a tonne cif Ghent for special quality material and July normal quality at $249.50 cif Rotterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
